Name: Arsyn's Carrot Mod
Author: spookykookyamber
Description: REJOICE! Carrots have arrived officially in the valley! But fret not! You can enjoy those carrots still. This is a replacement/update to my carrot plant mod that removes the carrot crop and seeds. Base game carrots work just fine with these recipes.
